name: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
description: SpongeBob and friends spend the summer catching jellyfish, building camp-fires, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck at Camp Coral, located in the Kelp Forest.

videos.title: I'm Urchin You to Leave
videos.overview: In this short, young SpongeBob and Patrick lure a sea urchin into the building.

videos.title: The Jellyfish Kid
videos.overview: A young SpongeBob is determined to catch his first jellyfish, so his friends do whatever they can to help him.

videos.title: Sugar Squeeze
videos.overview: The campers meet two backwoods narwhals named Narlene and Nobby, who treat them to a sweet surprise.

videos.title: Tag, You're It
videos.overview: On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag.

videos.title: Quest for Tire
videos.overview: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing, so the campers must hunt it down like their primal ancestors.

videos.title: Cabin of Curiosities
videos.overview: A mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark.

videos.title: In Search of Camp Noodist
videos.overview: SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony.

videos.title: Kitchen Sponge
videos.overview: SpongeBob helps Plankton at the Krusty Kanteen, leading to the development of a very familiar sandwich.

videos.title: The Treasure of Kamp Koral
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find buried treasure at camp, but Mr. Krabs becomes desperate to get his claws on it.

videos.title: Camper Gary
videos.overview: SpongeBob disguises Gary as a new camper to keep him safe from Mrs. Puff.

videos.title: Midnight Snack Attack
videos.overview: After SpongeBob and Patrick eat a secret snack experiment, Plankton must reverse the monstrous side effects.

videos.title: Hot Pearl-tato
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs needs to find a babysitter for little Pearl, but she proves too much for the campers to handle.

videos.title: What About Meep?
videos.overview: When an unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers, SpongeBob and Patrick must help him find his true identity.

videos.title: Hard Time Out
videos.overview: SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to rectify the situation.

videos.title: Pat's A Li'l Sinker
videos.overview: Mrs. Puff gives swimming lessons to Patrick after realizing he never got his swim badge.

videos.title: Camp SpongeBob
videos.overview: SpongeBob finds himself all alone in the camp, but that doesn't stop him from having a blast.

videos.title: Squisery
videos.overview: Patrick and Squidward must survive together in the woods after Squidward twists all of his ankles.

videos.title: Game Night
videos.overview: The adults sneak away to play a board game, but they have to hide from one camper in particular.

videos.title: My Fair Nobby
videos.overview: When Nobby becomes too civilized for Narlene, SpongeBob and Patrick help him remember his backwoods ways.

videos.title: Gimme a News Break
videos.overview: Perch and his pal Harvey report the news of Kamp Koral, but they stumble upon evidence of a ridiculous conspiracy!

videos.title: Wise Kraken
videos.overview: It's stand-up comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream.

videos.title: Squatch Swap
videos.overview: Patrick gets confused with a young Seasquatch while out in the woods.

videos.title: The Ho! Ho! Horror!
videos.overview: Santa Claus visits the children of Kamp Koral, who aren't quite sure what to make of the jolly giant.

videos.title: Outhouse Outrage
videos.overview: The outhouse explodes in front of Mr.Krabs, but he gets three different sides of the story from his campers.

videos.title: Are You Afraid of the Dork?
videos.overview: The counselors tell scary stories around the campfire, but things get truly spooky when a real ghost appears!

videos.title: Help Not Wanted
videos.overview: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral.

videos.title: Camp Spirit
videos.overview: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.

videos.title: Hill-Fu
videos.overview: It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle, and SpongeBob trains to beat the butt-kicking Sandy.

videos.title: Sun’s Out, Fun’s Out
videos.overview: It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.

videos.title: First and Last Aid
videos.overview: Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse, but she needs to dedicate all her time and effort to keeping SpongeBob safe.

videos.title: Night of the Living Stench
videos.overview: When all the campers try to win the 'Stinkiest Camp in the Forest' award, Squidward has to fend for his life to stay clean.

videos.title: Camp Crossbones
videos.overview: After SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy are banned from playing pirate outside, they decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship.

videos.title: The Jelly Life
videos.overview: SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.

videos.title: Lake Crashers
videos.overview: The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck.

videos.title: Boo Light Special
videos.overview: Desperate for help, Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store.

videos.title: Painting with Squidward
videos.overview: Counselor Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition.

videos.title: Kamp Kow
videos.overview: The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cute cow with a big appetite.

videos.title: Helter Shelter
videos.overview: SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins.

videos.title: Reveille Revolution
videos.overview: Squidward has to earn back his morning 'Reveille' duties.

videos.title: The Switch Glitch
videos.overview: An accident causes Patrick and Karen to switch bodies.

videos.title: Prickly Pests
videos.overview: A mischievous camp prank goes terribly wrong.

videos.title: Are You Smarter Than a Smart Cabin?
videos.overview: In an effort to avoid doing chores, Sandy invents a 'Smart Cabin.'

videos.title: Deep Sea Despot
videos.overview: Squidward takes over as Camp Master.

videos.title: Regi-Hilled
videos.overview: Narlene and Nobby teach Regigille all about backwoods living.

videos.title: The Perfect Camper
videos.overview: The Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games.

videos.title: Eye of the Hotdog
videos.overview: Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something.

videos.title: Patrick Takes the Cake
videos.overview: Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness.

videos.title: The Taste of Defeat
videos.overview: Plankton discovers competition in Narlene's backwoods restaurant.

videos.title: Scaredy Squirrel
videos.overview: Sandy spends a night at the Trawler cabin.

videos.title: Hats Off to Space
videos.overview: The Dinghies travel to outer space.

videos.title: In a Nut’s Shell
videos.overview: After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves as Camp Master Krabs.

videos.title: Mad Science Squirrel
videos.overview: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab.

videos.title: To Pop a Bubble
videos.overview: SpongeBob is determined to find out who popped his new bubble friend.

videos.title: High and Dry
videos.overview: The Dinghy cabin camps overnight out of the water.

videos.title: The Beardsman
videos.overview: Wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp.

videos.title: Five Times the Fun
videos.overview: When Patrick’s detached limbs regrow into five Patrick clones, it’s up to the gang to stop them before they take over the camp.

videos.title: Low Falutin'
videos.overview: Rea and Roh get a taste of the cheap life after they lose all their money.

videos.title: Nut Madness
videos.overview: Things get nutty at camp when Sandy goes feral over the sight of peanuts.

videos.title: Mermaid Men and Barnacle Boys
videos.overview: The Dinghy and Pontoon cabins go head-to-head in a series of superhero challenges.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Roxies
videos.overview: It’s a classic case of sibling rivalry after the conjoined Roxie sisters split up.

videos.title: Nite Owls
videos.overview: When the Dinghies attempt to stay up all night, they discover a side of camp they’ve never seen before.

videos.title: Calling Some Monsters
videos.overview: Realizing the monsters are actually quite boring, SpongeBob and Patrick set out to help them channel their wild side.

videos.title: Dig This
videos.overview: A mysterious bone discovery at Kamp Koral leads Sandy to start an archeological dig.

videos.title: Un-Breaking and De-Entering
videos.overview: SpongeBob discovers that Gary's been secretly taking items from everyone in camp.

videos.title: Swimmin' Holed
videos.overview: After SpongeBob and Patrick discover Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole, it doesn't stay a secret for long.

videos.title: Krabsy the Klown
videos.overview: When Mr. Krabs reveals that he used to be a clown, SpongeBob convinces him to wear the big shoes once again.

videos.title: Lords of the Larp
videos.overview: Mo joins the Pontoon cabin’s LARP (live action role-playing) group.

videos.title: Mascot Mayhem
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to become Kamp Koral's mascot.

videos.title: Putt Up or Shut Up
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs and Squidward compete head-to-head to see who is the better golfer.

videos.title: Who's Complaining?
videos.overview: Mr. Krabs puts Squidward in charge of Kamp Koral’s complaint department.

videos.title: Patrick's Star
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Sandy gift Patrick a star for his birthday.

videos.title: A Finful of Sand Dollars
videos.overview: Sheriff Sandy pulls out all the stops when a ne’er-do-well interloper turns Kamp Koral’s Western Day upside down.

videos.title: Cretins of the Night
videos.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick discover the ups and downs of vampire life with Kidferatu’s help.

videos.title: The Suit Suits You
videos.overview: Sandy learns the dangers of untested technology while an old companion goes on a journey of self-discovery.

videos.title: Parasite Pals
videos.overview: SpongeBob’s relationship with the rest of camp is pushed to the brink by his newest friend, a parasite living in his body.

videos.title: End of Summer Daze
videos.overview: Summer is over, and SpongeBob and Patrick stay behind for one final attempt to catch a jellyfish – but they’re not the only ones hiding out at camp.

country: United States, India, Canada, South Korea
